title.zh: GPU 粒子：计算 + 实例化

summary.zh: 十几万个粒子完全在 GPU 上模拟：计算 pass 原地更新存储缓冲，渲染 pass 直接从同一缓冲读取并实例化绘制。
summary.en: 130k+ particles simulated entirely on the GPU: a compute pass updates a storage buffer in place and a render pass draws instanced quads straight from it.

zh: 把 count 调到 1M，看帧率能否保持；再把 point size 调大，观察填充率的影响。
把 swirl 设为负数，粒子会反向旋转；按住鼠标试试更强的吸引。
在计算着色器里改用 @builtin(global_invocation_id) gid，用 gid.x 作为粒子下标。
en: Push count to 1M and see whether the frame rate holds; then raise point size and watch fill rate bite.
Make swirl negative to reverse the orbit, and hold the mouse button for a stronger pull.
Use @builtin(global_invocation_id) gid in the compute shader and index particles with gid.x.
